config.heading: Configuration: {class_name}
config.intro: Adjust the weight of each solver constraint. Higher positive values make the solver prioritise that rule more strongly. Negative values act as penalties. Changes are saved automatically.
config.teacher_weights_desc: These weights control how strongly teacher-defined rules influence the seat assignment.
config.keep_apart_desc: Per-unit distance reward for maximising separation between two pupils.
config.compat_pairs_desc: Reward applied when a compatible pair is seated directly next to each other.
config.pupil_weights_desc: These weights control how strongly pupil-defined preferences influence the seat assignment.
config.sit_next_to_desc: Reward when two pupils who want to sit next to each other are adjacent.
config.avoid_desc: Penalty (negative value) when two pupils who want to avoid each other are adjacent.
config.performance_desc: Distance reward/penalty based on pupil performance. Lower performance pulls closer to the teacher.
config.how_weights_1: The solver maximises a total score built from all constraints. Each weight scales the contribution of that rule. Doubling a weight makes the solver twice as eager to satisfy that constraint relative to others.
config.how_weights_2: For Keep Apart, the weight is multiplied by the Manhattan distance between seats, so even small increases have a large effect. Start with the defaults if you are unsure.
config.warning: Changes take effect on the next seat assignment run. Re-generate the assignment after updating weights.
